say:1:1611037201:0.text: Envoy Evie, as Chief Court Mage, I must insist you release young Gervan.
say:1:1611037201:0.source_cn: 伊芙特使，身为首席宫廷魔法师，我希望你释放这位名叫格墨...

say:2:1611037202:0.text: As one of the top contenders in the selection exam, he's already made it to the finals—and I dare say, he has every chance of becoming the next court mage, serving the royal family directly.
say:2:1611037202:0.source_cn: 格墨文作为选拔赛的顶尖选手，已经晋级最后的决赛，有很大...

say:3:1611037203:0.text: Now, detaining him without <style="highlight">solid evidence</style>? That would be a breach of imperial law... and, let's be honest, not the kind of impression you'd want to leave, would it?
say:3:1611037203:0.source_cn: 鉴于并没有<style=highlight>实质性的证...

say:4:1611037204:0.source_cn: 这是哪位大人物的命令吗？

say:5:1611037205:0.text: Oh, no one's issuing orders. Merely the advice of a humble servant of the Empire... and a gentle reminder of what the law demands.
say:5:1611037205:0.source_cn: 不，这是我身为首席宫廷魔法师的权利，也是我基于帝国法律...

say:8:1611037206:0.text: As Magister Cyran said, you lack evidence for your accusations.
say:8:1611037206:0.source_cn: 正如迪尔格雷大人所说的，你没有证据证明你对格墨文的一系...

say:9:1611037207:0.text: The Lyceum board is deeply concerned about this matter. I'm here representing them, asking for Gervan's immediate release.
say:9:1611037207:0.source_cn: 莱希拉姆校董事会非常关注这件事，我代表董事会出面，希望...

say:10:1611037208:0.text: I've also received a personal letter from Marquis Hastings, Gervan's grandfather.
say:10:1611037208:0.source_cn: 除此之外，我也收到了一封来自嘉德侯爵大人——也即格墨文...

say:11:1611037209:0.text: The Marquis... requests that you follow the law, rather than personal whims.
say:11:1611037209:0.source_cn: 信中，侯爵大人恳请特使按照法律的规则，而非个人意志行事。

say:12:1611037210:0.source_cn: 这么说，你们是要逼我放人了。

say:15:1611037211:0.text: "Force" is such an ugly word, don't you think? Let's say it's a friendly suggestion, with the Empire's best interests at heart.
say:15:1611037211:0.source_cn: 这不是逼迫，只是善意的建议。伊芙特使。

say:16:1611037212:0.text: And do trust me, <style="highlight">Her Majesty</style> would hardly hold it against you.

say:17:1611037213:0.text: Cyran, mind your tongue! Her Majesty has nothing to do with this.
say:17:1611037213:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，请慎言！这件事与王后陛下无关。

say:18:1611037214:0.text: Ah... is that so? Then I must have been misinformed. My mistake entirely. Now, as for Gervan's detention...
say:18:1611037214:0.source_cn: 啊，看来是某些片面的消息混淆了我的视听。那么，关于格墨...

say:19:1611037215:0.text: ... It seems I have no choice. Gervan, you're free to go.
say:19:1611037215:0.source_cn: ……看来我没有拒绝的权利。格墨文，你可以走了。

say:22:1611037216:0.text: I told you, Envoy Evie. <style="highlight">Some things are beyond your control.</style>
say:22:1611037216:0.source_cn: 伊芙特使，我说过的，这件事<style=highlig...

say:23:1611037217:0.text: Master Cyran, Headmistress Durella, shall we?
say:23:1611037217:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷大人，杜瑞拉女士，我们走吧。
